title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: employer-sponsored wellness-reimbursement rate and annual cap by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's tier basis for the percentage of dues an employer reimburses through a wellness-reimbursement waiver, and the annual dollar cap on that reimbursement.

| Tier | Wellness-reimbursement percentage | Annual wellness-reimbursement cap |
|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | 0% | $0.00 |
| Small Business Partner | 25% | $100.00 |
| Mid-Market Partner | 30% | $150.00 |
| Enterprise Partner | 40% | $250.00 |
| Municipal Partner | 30% | $150.00 |
| Nonprofit Partner | 35% | $150.00 |

These two figures size and cap a wellness-reimbursement waiver; how the waiver amount is actually calculated and capped is stated in a separate document.
